title: Hired for the Rosemont Ballroom and the trip to New York
summary: The owner of the Rosemont Ballroom in Brooklyn heard the radio broadcasts and hired the band; they came north by boat from Georgia.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right. Let's pause a moment.
There we go. Well, Cootie, who arranged
how the band would travel up to New York? How did that happen, come up by boat?
Well, I don't know that end of the business, you know.
Yeah.
But I know that we went to Georgia. When we got to Georgia --
From --
From --
From Miami.
Yeah. And got on that boat and come to New York.
Well, what -- my geography's terrible -- what boat would you get on? I mean, how would you come from Georgia?
In Savannah, Georgia.
But what would that be, coming up the coast, or what?
Yeah.
Really?
Yeah.
No kidding. What kind of a boat? What do you remember about it?
I don't remember nothing about that boat.
Had you ever been on a boat before?
No.
You didn't get sick, huh?
I didn't care how I got to New York.
You would just know you were going to New York.
Because, Helen, when I used to say my prayers at night, I used to say, "Dear Lord, please hurry up and let me grow up so I can get to New York."
(Laughter)
I didn't care how I got there. I was coming.
(Laughter)
Well, where did you land? Do you remember?
Yeah, we landed down at the pier, some pier down here.
In Manhattan someplace.
Then we were shuffled off to Brooklyn.
Yeah.
Though I didn't know Brooklyn from any other part of New York.
No.
So we were staying over in Brooklyn, at some lady's house. So we finished the two weeks --
Well, what was it like? What was the Rosemont like? I don't remember that.
The Rosemont Ballroom? It was --
Something like the Roseland?
Yeah. Something like Roseland.
Pretty big?
Yeah.
Yeah. And they had popular bands there? Williams
Yeah. Fess Wiggins used to play there.
Really?
Yeah. Other bands used to play there.
Did they -- they didn't have a broadcast from there, did they? They didn't have a line in there did they?
No.
No.
I don't think so.
Yeah. But, so you went in for two weeks.
